name: field
title: Field
description: Label, control, help and error wired together for forms.

a11y.pattern: Visible <label for> with aria-describedby help and error
keyboard: Moves between controls in DOM order
aria: aria-describedby lists the help and error ids
aria-invalid="true" when an error is shown
required attribute on the control; the asterisk is aria-hidden
Errors have an icon and the visually hidden word "Error"
a11y.notes: On submit, also render an error summary (role="alert") that links to each invalid field. Explain the asterisk once near the form ("* required").
